non_dependency_updates.name: Define customer match rules and confidence thresholds
non_dependency_updates.details: Specify the matching strategy: deterministic keys (exact email, normalized phone) and fuzzy keys (name + address similarity), the blocking strategy to keep comparisons tractable, the similarity scoring method, and the confidence thresholds that separate auto-merge from manual review. Output: written rule set plus a scored test set of known duplicate and non-duplicate pairs.

non_dependency_updates.name: Add watermarking and idempotent incremental loads
non_dependency_updates.details: Track a per-file and per-row watermark and upsert by natural key so reruns never duplicate rows, including support for resuming a partially processed file. Output: two consecutive runs prove no duplicate inserts and correct row deltas.

non_dependency_updates.name: Build error-rate and traffic metric aggregations
non_dependency_updates.details: Materialize per-service and per-endpoint error counts and error rate, request volume over time, and top error codes into the metrics table at 1-minute and 1-hour granularity. Add the scheduled refresh for these aggregates. Output: populated metrics verified against manual log counts.

non_dependency_updates.name: Implement error-rate and latency anomaly rules
non_dependency_updates.details: Two explainable rules: error rate exceeding a rolling baseline by N sigma, and p95 latency regressing past a set threshold. Each emits an anomaly record with severity, the baseline it was compared against, and a link to the contributing log slice. Output: rules replayed against historical data with the false-positive rate measured.

non_dependency_updates.name: Build dashboard page layout and KPI sections
non_dependency_updates.details: Implement the app shell, responsive grid, KPI header, and page sections from the approved wireframes, using placeholder data only. Output: navigable layout that matches the wireframes at desktop width.
